comments.body:
> Yeah, this looks like my bug. I'm chasing the details, but expect I'll have a fix relatively shortly.

I haven't forgotten this, it's just turning out to be more of a headache than expected.  I've tried a couple approaches, and keep hitting self-recursion bugs of different forms.  I believe this to be an edge case bug, if anyone is actually seeing this in practice beyond the fuzzer failure, let me know and I'll go with a hack as opposed to spending more time trying to find "the right fix".

issue.title: [RISC-V][LoopUnroll] Segfault in `llvm::TargetLoweringBase::getTypeConversion`

tests.test_body:
define void @legalization_crash() {
  %1 = bitcast <24 x i8> undef to <192 x i1>
  %2 = trunc <192 x i8> undef to <192 x i1>
  %3 = zext <192 x i1> undef to <192 x i8>
  %4 = sext <192 x i1> undef to <192 x i8>
  %5 = sitofp <192 x i1> undef to <192 x float>
  %6 = uitofp <192 x i1> undef to <192 x float>
  %7 = fptosi <192 x float> undef to <192 x i1>
  %8 = fptoui <192 x float> undef to <192 x i1>
  ret void
}

define void @oddvec_sizes() {
  %1 = sext <3 x i8> undef to <3 x i16>
  %2 = sext <7 x i8> undef to <7 x i32>
  %3 = sext <15 x i8> undef to <15 x i32>
  %4 = zext <3 x i8> undef to <3 x i16>
  %5 = zext <7 x i8> undef to <7 x i32>
  %6 = zext <15 x i8> undef to <15 x i32>
  %7 = trunc <3 x i32> undef to <3 x i8>
  %8 = trunc <7 x i32> undef to <7 x i8>
  %9 = trunc <15 x i32> undef to <15 x i8>
  %10 = bitcast <3 x i32> undef to <3 x float>
  %11 = bitcast <7 x i32> undef to <7 x float>
  %12 = bitcast <15 x i32> undef to <15 x float>
  %13 = sitofp <3 x i32> undef to <3 x float>

  %15 = sitofp <15 x i32> undef to <15 x float>
  %16 = uitofp <3 x i32> undef to <3 x float>
  %17 = uitofp <7 x i32> undef to <7 x float>
  %18 = uitofp <15 x i32> undef to <15 x float>
  %19 = fptosi <3 x float> undef to <3 x i32>
  %20 = fptosi <7 x float> undef to <7 x i32>
  %21 = fptosi <15 x float> undef to <15 x i32>

  %24 = fptoui <15 x float> undef to <15 x i32>
  ret void
